classes.name: PgSQL
classes.description: A class providing interface methods for PostgreSQL database operations such as connecting, querying, escaping strings, and retrieving metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the PostgreSQL database with provided host, username, password, database name, and optional port.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result encapsulated in an object with rows, row, and num_rows properties.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
